definitions.gloss: reconstruction; rebuilding; restructuring; remaking from scratch
definitions.explanation: Building something again from the ground up, whether a physical structure, a system, a relationship, or an organization. Implies a fundamental redesign rather than minor repairs.

examples.japanese: {信頼関係|しんらいかんけい}を{再構築|さいこうちく}する。
examples.english: To rebuild a relationship of trust.

examples.japanese: システムの{再構築|さいこうちく}には{時間|じかん}がかかる。
{老朽化|ろうきゅうか}した{組織|そしき}を{一|いち}から{再構築|さいこうちく}する{必要|ひつよう}がある。
examples.english: The aging organization needs to be rebuilt from scratch.

notes: Composed of {再|さい} (again) + {構築|こうちく} (construction, building). Takes する to form a verb. Common collocations: {信頼|しんらい}の{再構築|さいこうちく} (rebuilding trust), {組織|そしき}の{再構築|さいこうちく} (restructuring an organization), システムの{再構築|さいこうちく} (rebuilding a system). In IT contexts, often refers to rebuilding a system or database. Distinct from {改修|かいしゅう} (renovation/patching) — {再構築|さいこうちく} implies starting over.
